name: Cascader
usage: Regions and addresses, nested categories, choosing a folder by path

props.name: options
props.description: The options of the first level.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Text shown while nothing is chosen.

props.name: showSearch
props.description: Lets the user type to search across all levels.

props.name: allowClear
props.description: Shows a clear button while something is chosen.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the field.

props.name: block
props.description: Fills the width of the container.

props.name: size
props.description: Size: `sm` in table rows and toolbars, `lg` for prominent forms. Without it, the size follows the density.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Appearance: `filled` (a borderless well in the surface, the default), `outlined` (surface background with a thin
border) or `borderless`.

props.name: status
props.description: Validation status, usually set by Form.Item.

props.name: id
props.description: Id of the input element, so that a `<label for>` can point to it (Form.Item sets it).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name, when there is no visible label.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of the element that labels the input.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: Id of the element that describes the input, such as a hint.

props.name: testId
props.description:
Test id, rendered as `data-testid`: on the root element of Select, TreeSelect, Cascader and AutoComplete, on the
input of DatePicker and TimePicker, and on an element that adds no box around the two inputs of a range picker.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focuses the input when it mounts.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Called when the input gets the focus.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when the input loses the focus.

props.name: onKeyDown
props.description: Called on key presses in the input.

modes.title: Single selection (default)
modes.description:
The value is the path from the first level to the chosen option, such as `['asia', 'cn', 'shanghai']`; `null`
when nothing is chosen.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allows choosing several options; the value becomes an array of paths.

props.name: showChecked
props.description:
With `multiple`: when all children of an option are chosen, show only the `parent` or only the `child`
options.

props.name: value
props.description:
Path of the chosen option, from the first level (controlled), such as `['asia', 'cn', 'shanghai']`.
`null` keeps it empty, and `undefined` makes it uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial path (uncontrolled).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new path; `null` when cleared.

modes.title: Multiple selection: `multiple`
modes.description:
Options are chosen with checkboxes, and the value is an array of paths. Choosing an option chooses all its
children; `showChecked` decides whether a fully chosen option is kept as one path or as the paths of its children.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allows choosing several options; the value becomes an array of paths.

props.name: showChecked
props.description: When all children of an option are chosen, show only the `parent` (the default) or only the `child` options.

props.name: value
props.description: Paths of the chosen options (controlled); `null` keeps it empty, and `undefined` makes it uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial paths (uncontrolled).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new paths.

types.name: CascaderOption<V>
types.summary: An option of Cascader; `children` are the options of the next level.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: Each level opens in its own column; `→` opens the next level and `←` goes back.

examples.name: Variants
examples.title: Search and multiple selection
examples.description: `showSearch` searches across all levels; `multiple` picks several values.
